faq_heading: Southlands real estate: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Figures are closed sales from Jared’s Paragon export; local facts come from official sources listed at the bottom. It has no listing feed yet.

Southlands is an MLS® sub-area of Vancouver. Between November 2025 to October 22, 2026, 35 homes sold there: 26 houses and 5 condos. 26 houses sold in Southlands with a median price of $2,966,250 (the middle half sold between $2,500,000 and $3,678,125), taking a median of 28 days to sell at 94.6% of the last list price; 4% sold above list.
Southlands home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

26 houses sold in Southlands with a median price of $2,966,250 (the middle half sold between $2,500,000 and $3,678,125), taking a median of 28 days to sell at 94.6% of the last list price; 4% sold above list. They had a median $857 per square foot, a median year built of 1970 and a median lot of 8,552 square feet. 5 condos sold in Southlands with a median price of $780,000, taking a median of 97 days to sell at 94.5% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $845 per square foot, a median year built of 2001 and a median strata fee of $657 a month.

faq.q: What did homes in Southlands sell for?
faq.a: 26 houses sold in Southlands between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $2,966,250.

faq.q: How long do homes take to sell in Southlands?
faq.a: The median was 28 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 94.6% of the last list price (4% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most houses in Southlands sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 26 houses that sold in Southlands went for between $2,500,000 and $3,678,125, around a median of $2,966,250.

faq.q: Do houses in Southlands sell above asking price?
faq.a: 4% of the 26 houses sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 94.6% of it.

faq.q: How old are the houses that sold in Southlands?
faq.a: The median year built was 1970 for the 26 houses sold in Southlands.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do houses in Southlands usually have?
faq.a: The median house that sold in Southlands had 4 bedrooms, from the 26 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Who can help me buy or sell in Vancouver?
faq.a: Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, works across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361 or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in Vancouver?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.
